description: This file defines the interface and macros for Lua's garbage collector, including object marking, states, and related functions.

methods.name: luaC_fix
methods.description: Fixes a garbage collected object, preventing it from being collected.

methods.name: luaC_freeallobjects
methods.description: Frees all garbage collected objects in the Lua state.

methods.name: luaC_step
methods.description: Performs a single step of the garbage collection process.

methods.name: luaC_runtilstate
methods.description: Runs the garbage collector until it reaches a specified state.

methods.name: luaC_fullgc
methods.description: Performs a full garbage collection cycle, optionally in emergency mode.

methods.name: luaC_newobj
methods.description: Creates a new garbage collected object.

methods.name: luaC_newobjdt
methods.description: Creates a new garbage collected object with a specific data type and offset.

methods.name: luaC_barrier_
methods.description: Barrier function for write barriers in GC.

methods.name: luaC_barrierback_
methods.description: Barrier function for backward write barriers.

methods.name: luaC_checkfinalizer
methods.description: Checks and sets up finalizers for objects.
